description: Header file defining interfaces, types, constants, and function prototypes for the LVCS (Concert Sound) module, including memory management, initialization, parameter control, and processing functions for stereo and mono-in-stereo audio formats.

methods.name: LVCS_Memory
methods.description: Handles memory allocation and deallocation for the LVCS module, returning memory requirements or allocated base addresses.

methods.name: LVCS_Init
methods.description: Creates or re-initializes an LVCS instance with specified memory and capabilities.

methods.name: LVCS_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration parameters of an LVCS instance.

methods.name: LVCS_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates parameters of an LVCS instance.

methods.name: LVCS_Process
methods.description: Processes input audio data through the LVCS algorithm, supporting headphone and speaker variants.
